contributions.technical_interpretation: The authors present a new RS code commitment framework that is independent of the underlying PCS. By aggregating multiple evaluation proofs into a single randomized evaluation, the scheme removes redundant commitments and eliminates the requirement for homomorphic PCS, achieving linear‑time proof generation while remaining compatible with any multilinear PCS.

contributions.technical_interpretation: The authors design a new multilinear PCS that merges RS code based commitment with group‑based commitment, yielding improved prover time and proof size compared to earlier RS‑based PCS constructions. This constitutes a novel PCS construction.
contributions.original_model_evidence_quote: LightLigero: a new RS code–based multilinear PCS: We further design a tailored multilinear PCS, LightLigero, by combining RS code based PCS with group based PCS.
contributions.original_model_authors_claim: LightLigero is a new RS code–based multilinear PCS that combines RS code based PCS with group based PCS, achieving O(n log n)·F + O(n log n)·G prover time and O(λ log n) proof size, improving asymptotically over previous RS‑based PCS schemes such as Deepfold and WHIR.
